{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values and data issues
print("\nUnique values in channel:", df['channel'].unique())
print("\nUnique values in status:", df['status'].unique())
print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for revenue as string with commas
print("\nSample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
